paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.29% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+2.12%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.46%). Brent crude changed +2.31% to 108.51. Gold changed +1.02% to 4,149.8999. Bitcoin changed +3.60% to 84,437.0. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.109%, a relative move of -1.56%. Among the firms tracked, Lazard (+8.18%) and BlackRock (+6.11%) moved the most.
